projects.name: Banyan Court Residence
projects.concept: A contemporary two-storey tropical courtyard house with two offset rectilinear wings: warm board-formed exposed concrete, reddish-brown perforated brick screens, deep teak-lined roof overhangs, slim dark-bronze window frames, mature central courtyard tree. Flat roofs, low concrete garden wall, broad shallow entry steps, dense tropical planting. Taller brick-screen upper wing at the right of the main street elevation; single-height fully glazed concrete living wing at the left.

projects.concept: A distinctive six-storey boutique apartment building on an urban tropical corner: ground floor plus five residential floors, warm ivory exposed-concrete horizontal bands, softly rounded balcony corners, offset generous planted terraces, slender bronze vertical privacy fins, recessed olive-gray glazing. A double-height recessed street lobby with a ribbed travertine wall; carefully integrated low planting. Mid-rise neighbors set back, no impossible overhangs.

projects.name: Tide House
projects.concept: An elegant two-storey coastal villa on a low dune above the sea: pale sand-colored limestone walls, a low sweeping flat roof with gently curved corners, deep bronze-framed glazing, vertical bleached-oak privacy screens, a long narrow lap pool parallel to the ocean. Main house is an L-shaped composition of two grounded volumes; no stilt house, no cliff-edge fantasy. Native dune grasses, stone terrace and restrained coastal landscaping.

projects.name: Stillwater Sanctuary
projects.concept: A single-storey contemporary contemplative sanctuary beside a still pond and bamboo grove: a long low charcoal board-formed concrete rectangular meditation hall, an offset warm rammed-earth entrance wall, a broad thin but structurally credible flat concrete roof supported by regular recessed columns, one circular skylight over the inner meditation space, narrow vertical cedar fins on one glazed facade. Raised dark stone plinth and accessible gently sloped approach, quiet minimal landscape. Secular wellness architecture, no religious symbols.

Central open courtyard, shaded public plaza with native trees. Honest functional public architecture, no logos or lettering.

projects.name: Canopy Ridge Retreat
projects.concept: A small refined forest retreat on a gentle wooded hillside: three separate one-storey timber guest pavilions linked by low raised timber walkways. Each pavilion has the same asymmetric single-slope pitched standing-seam dark-zinc roof, warm vertical cedar cladding, dark stone base and full-height bronze-framed forest-facing glazing. A slightly larger common lounge pavilion repeats this roof form. Sensible modest spans and low stone retaining walls, natural ferns and tall temperate forest, no tropical palms or precarious cliffs.

projects.name: Atelier Courtyard Offices
projects.concept: A four-storey creative office courtyard building in a dense urban arts district: ground floor plus three floors, an elegant exposed pale-concrete grid, oxidized terracotta baguette screening, deep recessed dark metal windows, a compact double-height entrance slot and a planted central open-air courtyard. A corner upper terrace cuts one bay out of the otherwise rectilinear mass. Grounded practical structure, a small street-facing cafe without signage, young street trees and real neighboring masonry buildings. Distinct from curving apartment architecture; crisp orthogonal grid.
